summary: Recovered source-backed antiviral syncytium activity rows, source-verified one-to-one DBAASP records, conflict-preserved aggregate database annotations, and bounded membrane-fusion mechanism claims.

caution_findings.finding: The source paper reports retroviral envelope-mediated membrane-fusion inhibition, not antibacterial MIC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity assays. Final activity rows therefore use antiviral syncytium endpoints and do not invent antimicrobial or toxicity values.

Exact IC50 values are captured only where the primary prose reports them. Inactive or partial mutant rows keep reported thresholds/percentages or qualitative no-detectable-activity language rather than digitizing curves for unreported values.

CAMP/dbAMP aggregate entry rows partly mirror source-backed antiviral values but compress target/assay/citation details; these are preserved as source_conflict while one-to-one DBAASP assay rows are source_verified.

Local supplementary .bin assets are Springer landing/support HTML pages for authors original figure files; no local spreadsheet, office, or supplementary data table changed activity/toxicity/mechanism curation.
